deal_value.notes: EUR 120M growth equity investment (minority stake) at a EUR 2.5B post-money valuation; ~USD 128M / ~USD 2.6B at June 2022 EUR/USD ~1.07 (per TechCrunch). Backbase's first-ever external funding.

calculable.calculation: EUR 2,500M valuation / EUR 200M+ revenue = ~12.5x (upper bound, since revenue stated only as 'over EUR 200 million')
inputs: EUR 120M raise at EUR 2.5B valuation - https://www.privateequitywire.co.uk/backbase-raises-eu120m-motive-partners-eu25bn-valuation/ and https://tech.eu/2022/06/09/bootstrapped-backbase-brings-in-eur120-million-at-eur25-billion-valuation/ (TechCrunch reported $128M at $2.6B: https://techcrunch.com/2022/06/09/backbase-raises-its-first-funding-128m-at-a-2-6b-valuation-for-tools-that-help-banks-with-engagement/)
Revenue 'grown organically to over EUR 200 million' - https://www.backbase.com/press/backbase-raises-120m-from-motive-partners
calculable.caveats: Revenue disclosed only as 'over EUR 200 million' with no period specified (presumably FY2021/TTM at announcement); valuation is a post-money equity valuation from a minority growth round, not a computed enterprise value. Both inputs soften the implied multiple.
